title: 専門ゼミ(電気電子工学科)
subtitle: Preparatory Seminar for Design Project III
keywords: Design Project III 2.Electrical Engineering 3.Electronic Engineering 4.Project Proposal
educationalGoal: To find some new challenges and these solutions in Design Project III (PD III) from a view point of electrical and/or electronic engineering, students acquire the basis of a comprehensive ability needed as engineer using their knowledge and skills through this seminar.
advice: ・ Through deeply understanding what kind of project in PD III, students clarify the necessary knowledge and skills. To carry out the selected project and to confirm own ability regarding its project, students learn more knowledge and skills through taking other courses. ・To implement the project of PD III, students acquire the basic knowledge and skills needed in academic and major fields of the project. ・Students achieve some skills such as finding/solving of problems, personal development, self-management, and communication through the examination of the academic papers related in the project and project results up to the previous year. ・Students recognize the importance notices and safety instructions of equipment in the assigned laboratory, and cultivate the engineering ethics. ・Students deeply consider your major field and future career. ・Students understand the contents of your project which will be implemented in PD III, identify the problems and those improvements of your project, and acquire the ability of proposing solutions. ・Finally, students make a project proposal of PD III. Through "Project Design Activity Support System" placed in the student portal, all students should submit the project proposal and also enter each activity regarding in PD III. To pass, students must earn at least 60 points out of 100.
books: Some materials will be delivered in each lab.
requiredKnowledge: Knowledge and skills, which are needed in each laboratory, will be explained in first seminar.

activityGoals.body: Be able to clearly imagine the goal of project and to propose the action plans of PD III.
Be able to explain the outline of PD III project.
Be able to acquire basic knowledge and skills in order to conduct the project independently.
Be able to learn about the design and research processes.
Be able to imagine own carrier vision.

achievementLevels.ideal: By the end of this course, students should be able to do the following: ・ Clearly imagine the goal of project and action plan of PD III, and well explain them to others. ・ Explain the outline of the project in detail. ・ Acquire the basic knowledge and skills needed in PD III and independently apply them to the project. ・ Acquire the design and research processes, and develop them to the project.
achievementLevels.standard: By the end of this course, students should be able to do the following: ・ Imagine the goal of project and action plan of PD III. ・ Explain the outline of the project in detail. ・ Acquire the basic knowledge and skills needed in PD III. ・ Acquire the design and research processes.

lessons.content: Introduce the main themes of PD III and explain about the outline of them. Explain about schedule of this seminar.
lessons.assignments: (Preview) Before beginning of this seminar, students should tour the assigned laboratory and inquiry about the project of PD III.

lessons.content: Education for safety and career design. (The time of these implementation will be announced in this seminar)
lessons.assignments: Students acquire the knowledge about general safety and career design.

lessons.content: Unique class will be carried out by each professor. For example, we will teach the basic knowledge needed for the project implementation.
lessons.operation: Lecture and discussion. We will confirm the understanding of the class contents by several methods such as quiz, exam, and paper.
lessons.assignments: For example, review of class contents and of the contents concerned with project.

lessons.content: Unique class will be carried out by each professor. For example, we will teach the basic knowledge needed for the project implementation and also supply some materials such as the research papers and research achievements up to last year.
lessons.operation: Lecture and discussion. We will confirm the understanding of the class contents by several methods such as quiz, exam, and paper.
lessons.assignments: For example, review of class contents and of the concerned contents with project.

lessons.content: Unique class will be carried out by each professor. For example, we will discuss about the proposal, coordination and decision of group formation and also explain about making of the project proposal.
lessons.operation: Lecture and discussion. We will decide the group formation for project implementation through discussion.
lessons.assignments: For example, students reconfirm the contents of the PD III project and also begin to consider the making of a project proposal.

lessons.content: Unique class will be carried out by each professor. For example, we will perform the preparation for project implementation, preliminary experiment and lecture for basic knowledge on each group.
lessons.operation: Lecture and discussion. We will confirm the understanding of the class contents by several methods such as quiz, exam, and paper.
lessons.assignments: For example, students reconfirm the contents of the PD III project and also begin to consider the making of a project proposal.

lessons.content: Final exam will be carried out by each professor. In addition, students should submit a project proposal summarize the contents of learning outcomes, and also perform a presentation for each group if needed. After finishing these class contents, self-check class will be conducted.
lessons.operation: Final exam and its review for evaluation. We will confirm the understanding of the class contents by several methods such as quiz, exam, and paper.
lessons.assignments: For example, students submit a project proposal. If required some corrections, a revised proposal must be resubmitted quickly. In preparation for the implementation of PD III, all students should clarify again the purpose of PD III and its implementation plan.
